preconditions.description: T is a positive integer representing the number of test cases.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(N, int) and N >= 2 for N in [N])
preconditions.description: For each test case, N is an integer >= 2 representing the number of nodes.

preconditions.expression: all(len(S) == N and all(c.islower() and c.isalpha() for c in S) for S in [S])
preconditions.description: S is a string of length N containing only lowercase English letters.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= N and 1 <= y <= N and x != y for x, y in edges)
preconditions.description: Edges connect distinct nodes within the valid range [1, N].

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= U <= N and 1 <= V <= N and U != V for U, V in queries)
preconditions.description: Queries consist of distinct node pairs within the valid range [1, N].
The sum of N and the sum of Q over all test cases do not exceed 2*10^5.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly Q lines per test case, matching the total number of queries.

postconditions.expression: all(line.strip().upper() in ['YES', 'NO'] for line in stdout_lines)
postconditions.description: Each output line is either 'YES' or 'NO' (case-insensitive).

postconditions.expression: all((line.strip().upper() == 'YES') == (has_common_char(DIS_V_LCA, DIS_U_LCA)) for line, (DIS_V_LCA, DIS_U_LCA) in zip(stdout_lines, query_results))
postconditions.description: For each query (U, V), output 'YES' if and only if there exists a character present in both DIS(V, LCA(U, V)) and DIS(U, LCA(U, V)), otherwise 'NO'. This is equivalent to checking if the intersection of character sets of the two strings is non-empty.
